sections.appearance: She wears a Japanese maid outfit, but with a longer skirt with two blue stripes on the bottom. She has long pale blonde hair. She also carries a big black box that carries what appears to be high explosives of some description. Halo ==== Akane's halo has a gray crosshair with edges inside along with a bigger circle with dashed tabs merged on the outside. Uniform ==== She has beige hair with loose hairlines tied in blue ribbon reaching to her waist and wears a French maid headdress and black glasses. She has soft gray eyes. She wears a typical French maid uniform with blue tie, and wears white gloves. long sleeves, and long white stockings with black maid shoes. She also wearing a beige plaid scarf around her arms. Firearm ==== thumb|Silent Solution|150px She uses a black Welrod Mk. I bolt-action pistol with light blue strips lining up the barrel and the breech handle. She also carries around a large suitcase containing several explosive charges.

sections.personality: Akane is caring in Sensei's presence, acting as their personal maid and performing the functions expected of her position, such as cleaning, supply management, and general housekeeping. She also shows a matronly attitude towards Neru, who is often annoyed by it. Akane also has a habit of "cleaning out" enemy with explosives, much to Yuuka's chagrin.
